notes: #10: the plate reads ‘Vermote del. 1813’ (drawing date); the lithograph by Dewasme & Cie, Tournai, was probably published in the 1820s. #19 is a smaller duplicate of #10. #20: Commons date 2005 is the scan date; the photo appeared in National Geographic vol. 31 (1917), so it was taken 1915–17. #11: LOC photochroms are usually dated ca. 1890–1900, so 1890s used. #9 (siege of 1678, about 1690) is an alternative P2 event view.
